notes: 'of the' is given to the first article, the second attributive article being unrepresented under rule 23, even though the ASV's word order puts 'the' next to 'Most High'.
καί in the τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί idiom is aligned to 'with'; leaving it unrepresented and folding 'with' into the σοί unit under rule 21 remains defensible.
τόν before θεόν is unrepresented and 'by' stays with the noun, the ASV writing no determiner (rules 21 and 23).
